The third piece of advice I was going to give you, after telling you how to EASILY CREATE AN APPLICATION around and idea or service as a none-technical person.  Then I told you how you can EASILY VALIDATE YOUR IDEA without any excuses. 

I'm saving Gatsby, our final secret tool, for @Renaissancefree members.  

The Renaissance is an environment, tucked inside the internet that will make some of the greatest businesses and individuals shine in the AI era. 

When we called it The Renaissance, we believe it, just like the period of rapid transformation from the 14th century to the 17th century where specific inventions changed the period. Da Vinci, Galileo etc.

We think the same thing is happening as we speak and in a world where software becomes easy your network becomes far more important. The opportunity just compounds over and over.

Your influence, your authority on topics, your track record. These things matter and creating a reputable business profile for your business and personal brand inside our community will unlock doors to opportunities far faster than remaining solo or in the hands of some of these communities on social media.

Launching a business on Product Hunt lasts a day and the dopamine dies.

Joining The Renaissance is an on-going collective meant to guide you as you up-skill your business acumen and AI skills over YEARS and massively increase your potential as a human being to make a dent in the universe.

So let me tell you...

HOW TO FINALLY JOIN:

Go to https://t.co/9q4dKMgxzX   

Stage 0:

Play the onboarding game which is hilarious by the way. It has been made to test your basic basic basic tech skills. A 10 year old should be able to game their way through.   

It has also be made to completely shut out 99% of bots. No bots, no spam, just a purely passionate community  for up-skilling in AI and maintaining an edge agains the market.   

STAGE 1: Complete Initiation

An equally hilarious yet totally different way of progressing through. 

- (first slightly boring) Put in a profile picture so we know who you are. Free membership can be anon, paid is not anonymous. Anon we find is eventually worse for networking in our professional circles and we'd rather teach you the path anyway if you're new.  

- THEN play our 🔉AMAZING VOICE BOT CONCIERGE 🔉which actually serves a genuine purpose and is the second time I've installed one of these in a place I actually think is valuable in the world. 

This tech is justtttt breaking into the commercial market and it will be fun for you to try it. The best part is that it collects all the information required to do a basic vetting of why you're here, and then fills out your idea in way more character than you would be bothered to write out in a normal community. SO PEOPLE ACTUALLY GET TO KNOW WHAT YOU DO.  

- Edit any of the explanation of your business our voice bot generates and hit initiate. We will do a basic vetting of you and if you aren't a bot and are generally passionate about AI or your work, we will accept you in as a free member.   

BOOM YOU'RE IN.

STAGE 2:

The doors open up, new pages become available. 

Now you have access to two rooms:

1) Voices - built like Club House with the ability to hold private discussions backed by AI technology that makes learning and up-skilling interactive and convenient. We'll be bringing in some big names from global enterprises to talk inside this space as well as start ups from all walks of life to talk about their journey.

You're welcome to join a voice chat and speak about the rest of the application, or get advice over how you should approach the next step:

2) Roast - here is your real test. You say you want to keep learning? The fastest way to learn is feedback. We let you list your application for free in our Roast room and allow a number of players to user test your app and do their best to Roast it. 

If you successfully prove inside the Roast room that you have fixed the roasts and made the changes, we know you are the type of person that is committed to optimising and improving, and your app will be ready for Stage 3.

STAGE 3: 

The Marketplace 🤑💰

Now we know you're a regular person, you're hard working, and you're willing to get roasted, we want to invite you to list your app for free on our marketplace.

If it's good, our community will upvote it and it will rise to the top.

If it does not get upvotes, you should put it back in the Roast page and ask exactly why. This will give you user testing feedback you might be missing and you can repeat this cycle of continuous improvement.

Members can message you directly from inside of the marketplace and can also form agreements and deals to partner on a wider basis, maybe wanting to sell in your application into their customer base.

The apps are categorised by the department that they would impact or the consumer they would target. Maintaining your app in the marketplace allows you to actively rank against 'competitors' aka your friends in the community that have just made a better app than you / probably worked harder.

This is the most fair I can think of for us to both grow an incredibly exciting business network and technology accelerator.

Prompt

Use the uploaded photo as the ONLY identity reference.

IMPORTANT:
This is an IMAGE EDIT task, NOT a text-to-image generation task.

Preserve the exact facial identity with full face lock. Do not redesign or beautify the person. Keep the exact face shape, eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, nose, lips, ears, jawline, skin tone, skin texture, hairstyle, hairline, expression, age, body proportions, hands, and every unique facial feature exactly the same as in the uploaded image. The final person must be 100% recognizable as the original.

Create a premium cinematic monochrome portrait in a stylish double-composition layout.

The background should be a soft outdoor environment with creamy bokeh and shallow depth of field.

Convert the entire scene into elegant black-and-white while keeping only the small decorative hearts in bright red.

Create two versions of the same person:

• A very large upper-body portrait occupying the left side of the frame, facing slightly sideways with a confident, calm expression.

• A smaller full-body portrait placed on the lower-right side, naturally walking forward with one hand inside the trouser pocket and the other arm relaxed.

The clothing should be modern smart-casual:
• Black collared button-up shirt with a smooth black-to-white gradient fade toward the lower sleeves and hem.
• White high-waisted tailored trousers.
• Black belt.
• Black sunglasses.
• Small hoop earrings.

Hair tied into a high ponytail with natural loose strands around the face.

Blend both portraits seamlessly with soft fog at the bottom to create a premium editorial collage.

Add elegant graphic elements:
• White handwritten brush-script text reading "It's Me" in the lower-left corner.
• Three to five small bright-red hearts around the text.
• A thin white dashed swirl leading toward a small white butterfly near the bottom.

A 22 year old from the UK asked Claude one question.

Not "how do I grow on TikTok."

Not "what hashtags work."

Just this:

"What's the actual blueprint for a million views?"

Claude's answer sounded almost too simple.

Build a virtual model.

Asian features.

Set her to trending dances.

Over popular tracks.

That's it.

No strategy deck.

No growth hacks.

No paid ads.

He read it and thought: pointless.

Felt like a shortcut with no substance behind it.

Most people would've closed the chat right there.

He didn't.

He tested it anyway.

Because that's the difference.

Everyone has access to the same AI.

Everyone can ask the same question.

Almost nobody follows through on the boring, weird-sounding answer.

The people who win aren't smarter.

They're just willing to try the thing that sounds stupid before it works.

Save this before you scroll past the next "obvious" idea that isn't.
